patch.summary: ActiveCampaign implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement ActiveCampaign by mapping current email-marketing workflows to ActiveCampaign objects, confirming plan gates for pipeline management (Plus, Professional, Enterprise), deal management (Plus, Professional, Enterprise), sales automation (Plus, Professional, Enterprise), piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Shopify, WordPress, Salesforce) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: pipeline management (Plus, Professional, Enterprise)
Integrate after: data quality pass on Shopify

blocks.heading: ActiveCampaign day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat ActiveCampaign setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for contact management before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Marketing-led SMBs that need automation as the primary email job before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Shopify and WordPress before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover pipeline management (Plus, Professional, Enterprise)
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Confirm live ActiveCampaign checkout; packaging can change.
Do not expand seats until contact management is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Confirm live ActiveCampaign checkout; packaging can change.

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: No forever-free plan — 14-day trial entry only

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Contact-tier pricing scales as the list grows — confirm live bands

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: CRM depth is secondary to email automation identity

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: ActiveCampaign plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Starter

blocks.title: Validate email-marketing fit before a deep ActiveCampaign rollout
blocks.body: If ActiveCampaign fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft ActiveCampaign object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on contact management
If blocked, evaluate Klaviyo before sunk-cost expansion
